GinJamTeam.

notes.title: v0.5: Controller support!
notes.content:
[b]Hey there![/b]

It's been a week since our Early Access release, and now we have a big update!

Basically, we've fully implemented controller support, so you can use your favorite one to play Clayers! We also added an auto-aim option, which is enabled by default.

If you haven't tried our game yet because it lacked controller support—now's the perfect time!

[b]Gin Jam Team[/b]
